hashSemantics.definitionsSha256: SHA-256 of RFC-8259 JSON for the root object after removing goldenFixture, recursively sorting every object key, preserving array order, using compact separators, UTF-8, and rejecting NaN/Infinity
hashSemantics.rawFileSha256: SHA-256 of the exact UTF-8 file bytes; provenance only, never substituted for definitionsSha256

sourceRoles.decision: the candle whose close makes the event available
sourceRoles.defining: candles required to calculate the event
sourceRoles.confirmation: right-side candles required to confirm a pivot

sensitivityProtocol.baseline: the fixed parameters in each module.parameters object
sensitivityProtocol.execution: execute every declared value including the baseline value; apply the same causal availability, overlap deduplication, horizons, and exclusions as the baseline family
sensitivityProtocol.comparison: report stored, eligible, realized and excluded counts, eligible decision-time Jaccard versus baseline, and mean forwardReturn/MFE/MAE plus delta versus baseline for 1/3/6 bars
sensitivityProtocol.selection: no winner selection, probability claim, predictive gate, promotion, PnL, or result-based parameter change

parameters.emaSeed: first close in each finite emaSourceBars window
parameters.rsiMethod: simple mean gain and loss over exactly rsiPeriod close changes; loss zero maps to 100
parameters.crossingRule: strict transition across the level using previous-window value and current-window value; equality belongs to the pre-cross side
parameters.sourceRule: union of previous and current calculation windows: EMA 61 candles at emaSourceBars=60, RSI rsiPeriod+2 candles, SMA smaPeriod+1 candles

inequalities.bullishEngulfing: previous red, current green, current open <= previous close, current close >= previous open
inequalities.bearishEngulfing: previous green, current red, current open >= previous close, current close <= previous open

parameters.baseline: arithmetic mean volume of the 20 immediately preceding contiguous finalized candles; current candle excluded
parameters.eventRule: emit one event for every threshold whose currentVolume/priorMean >= threshold; nested threshold events are retained

parameters.trendRule: over up to five prior close changes ending at decision: up when up>=4 and down<=1, down when down>=4 and up<=1, otherwise sideways; fewer than three changes is sideways
parameters.volatilityRule: trueRange/close compared with median of up to 20 strictly prior contiguous values; fewer than 10 prior values is insufficient_history; high >=1.5*median, low <=0.67*median, otherwise normal
parameters.eventRule: begin transition evaluation at current index volatilityMinimumPriorBars+1 so both current and previous contexts have sufficient volatility history; emit only when the ordered pair (trend,volatility) differs from the previous contiguous candle
parameters.sourceRule: continuous union needed to recompute previous and current contexts, from max(segmentStart,currentIndex-volatilityPriorBars-1) through currentIndex inclusive; 12 candles at the first eligible comparison and at most 22 candles
parameters.legacyComparability: new causal reconstruction; not comparable to legacy ADX/ATR/Bollinger MarketRegimes rows

parameters.pivotHighRule: center high strictly greater than every high in center±radius excluding center
parameters.pivotLowRule: center low strictly lower than every low in center±radius excluding center
parameters.tieRule: equal extrema are not pivots; if one candle satisfies both strict high and strict low, pivot high wins
parameters.anchorRule: retain latest confirmed pivot; emit a leg only when the next confirmed pivot has opposite type
parameters.availabilityRule: pivot at center is available at close of center+radius; event uses that confirmation candle
parameters.sourceRule: continuous range from priorPivotCenter-radius through currentPivotCenter+radius inclusive, proving both pivots and absence of an intervening confirmed opposite pivot

parameters.binRule: uniform [windowLow,windowHigh] bins; typical=(high+low+close)/3; floor index with exact upper bound clamped to last bin; reported level is bin midpoint
parameters.pocTieRule: lowest bin index wins equal volume
parameters.valueAreaRule: rank all bins by descending volume then ascending bin index and include until cumulative volume >= valueAreaFraction*total; VAH=max selected midpoint, VAL=min selected midpoint
parameters.eventRule: compare previous close to previous-window level and current close to current-window level; emit strict below-to-at-or-above or above-to-at-or-below transition
parameters.sourceRule: union of previous and current rolling windows, exactly windowBars+1 contiguous finalized candles
parameters.estimateDisclosure: OHLCV approximation; full bar volume is not an observed price-by-volume distribution

parameters.eventRule: at one finalized close, count distinct aligned module names after token mapping; emit when count >= minimumAlignedModules; no archetype, future outcome, predictive rate or model input is allowed
parameters.conflictRule: aggregate direction within each module first; a module with both bullish and bearish events at the same close is neutral. If distinct-module bullish and bearish counts both meet the threshold, emit both events in BULL then BEAR order and label aggregate payload direction Conflict
parameters.sourceRule: union of all source candles from aligned same-close input events
